title: Ridley Scott to accept his honorary Oscar by video at tonight's Governors Awards
summary: Glenn Close and animator Floyd Norman will also receive honorary Oscars in Hollywood.
body:
Director Ridley Scott will accept his honorary Oscar through a pre-recorded speech at the Academy's Governors Awards in Hollywood tonight, Sunday 15 November, rather than in person.

The Hollywood Reporter says the London-based director has been advised not to fly after a minor medical procedure. His wife, children and grandchildren will attend on his behalf.

Also being honoured

The actress Glenn Close and the animator Floyd Norman will also receive honorary Oscars. Producers Christine Vachon and Pamela Koffler will be given the Irving G. Thalberg Memorial Award.

Scott, whose films include Alien, Blade Runner and Gladiator, turns 89 later this month.

Sources: The Hollywood Reporter, WION, Yahoo Entertainment.
